claim_ceiling: Complementary role of dense embeddings fully characterized at maximum available scale (22yr/144k). Three modes validated: (1) Citation heritage recovery AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74 — PASSED; (2) Section cross-lingual Sachverhalt 0.282 > 0.2, Dispositiv 0.150 > 0.1 — PASSED (Erwaegungen 0.094 < 0.1 — FAILED); (3) Linear hybrid complement PASS adversarial at 19yr+ but JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79 — PARTIAL. Fundamental two-mode tradeoff confirmed: TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY product mode; dense embeddings = COMPLEMENTARY modes. Full 174k evaluation blocked by bge_/bger_ ID mapping + missing parquet 2022-2026 (29,520 decisions).
evidence_summary: All 12 evidence_refs verified accessible and internally consistent. Citation heritage: 21yr AUC 0.8455 (100 pairs), 22yr AUC 0.7946 (344 pairs) — dense > TF-IDF citation-based. Section cross-lingual: 1K sample, Sachverhalt cp_64 cross_lang_same_branch=0.282, Dispositiv=0.150, Erwaegungen=0.094. Linear hybrids: weight sweep 22yr shows optimal w=0.4 (cited_decisions_tfidf JP=0.6725) and w=0.3 (hybrid05 JP=0.6115), both PASS adversarial gates but below TF-IDF baseline JP=0.784/0.789. Center projected FAILS jurist gate all scales (max JP=0.4265 at 22yr). Legal TF-IDF bge_ corpus: 6-8/14 PASS vs 14/14 baseline, root cause corpus mismatch confirmed. v18 coarse hierarchy: best purity 0.65 < 0.7 threshold. Boilerplate resistance negative all reps (score -0.74 to -0.93). Four fundamental data blockers verified unfixable in this cycle. Negative results preserved as first-class evidence per Research Protocol.
